You'd build the Natuvion Cloud Portal, the Go/gRPC platform at the center of the company. It's the cloud counterpart to our core products and the central access point nearly every team works through, used by our own people and our customers alike. A year old, already the strategic core, mostly greenfield, and growing fast.

What to expect

The work is varied, and the problems rarely repeat. One stretch you might be making multi-tenant queries fly across 100 GiB+ tables in DuckDB; the next, packing a couple dozen services into a single binary a customer can run on-prem, or building our AI firewall, deep-packet inspection for AI traffic that decides, per customer and per user, exactly which AI tools and MCP servers are allowed. It's the kind of fine-grained control that enterprises with sensitive data actually need and almost nobody has built.

The stack is deliberately solid, though we'll reach for newer tools where the benefit is substantial. Go and gRPC throughout, with Google's AIPs as a strict ruleset so our APIs stay compatible as the platform grows. We run on AWS/EKS and on-prem with no vendor lock-in, backed by PostgreSQL, RabbitMQ, Redis, OpenSearch and a Grafana/Loki/Mimir/Jaeger stack, all shipped through GitHub Actions. Authorization is one such case: the platform's entire authz system is built on SpiceDB/Zanzibar, newer and less battle-tested, but exactly the right tool for the job. There's a dedicated SRE team, but you build it, you run it. You'd join four backend engineers, a flat team with a hands-on technical lead, and we're hiring across backend and frontend to keep up.

Your Responsibilities :

  • Design and build the gRPC services at the heart of the Cloud Portal, APIs that other teams depend on and that must stay compatible as the platform grows

  • Take services end to end: design, ship, and run them in production, across both cloud and on-prem

  • Solve the performance and scaling problems that come with multi-tenant systems and large datasets

  • Help shape architecture and technical direction, where your input genuinely moves things in a team this small


  • 5+ years writing production-grade Go

  • Strong grasp of idiomatic Go, concurrency patterns, and profiling with pp

title: Backend Engineer – API Integrationen, Connectoren, Worker/Jobs, Mailer Service, QA
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Backend Engineer – API Integrationen, Connectoren, Worker/Jobs, Mailer Service, QA based in Germany.

This role is an opportunity to build robust backend systems and integrations that connect critical business platforms and services. You’ll work across APIs, connectors, background jobs, messaging, email delivery, persistence, and quality assurance. The position requires an engineering mindset focused on reliability, traceability, and handling real-world failure scenarios rather than relying on happy-path implementations. You’ll design integrations that remain resilient through rate limits, webhooks, timeouts, retries, and other operational challenges. Working on a project basis, you’ll have significant ownership over technical deliverables and architecture decisions. This is a strong fit for a backend engineer who enjoys solving complex integration problems and building dependable production systems.


Accountabilities
  • Build and maintain production-ready API integrations and connectors, prioritizing Box and HubSpot, followed by Microsoft Graph, Asana, and billing-related systems.
  • Implement reliable authentication and integration patterns using OAuth, webhooks, pagination, rate limits, retries, and robust error handling.
  • Design and develop queue-driven, stateful, and replayable workers and background jobs.
  • Build and maintain a mailer service supporting PDF attachments, structured logging, retry mechanisms, delivery checks, and deduplication/idempotency.
  • Design database schemas and implement clean, reliable migrations using PostgreSQL or comparable technologies.
  • Implement audit events and persistent traceability mechanisms, including correlation IDs and observability across distributed processes.
  • Develop comprehensive QA coverage, including contract tests, integration tests, and end-to-end regression testing for critical workflows such as document delivery and deadline-related processes.
  • Use Docker, queue/eventing technologies, and observability practices to support reliable deployment and operation of backend services.
  • Proactively identify failure modes

What's it all about?

The balance of power in the energy industry needs to change. The intermittency of renewable supply and the constant demands of the grid mean that we still rely on less efficient, more expensive and unsustainable fossil fuels to keep the lights on. At Gridfuse, our mission is to shift this balance through technology. To shift the balance of inputs, so that renewables become the world's main source of electricity.  

At Gridfuse, we develop the software that controls real renewable energy assets and turns them into a coordinated Virtual Power Plant (VPP) that can respond intelligently to energy markets and grid conditions.

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will build the systems that connects our platform to these assets and turn energy-market and grid requirements into real-world actions.   • Take your services from architecture and implementation through deployment, monitoring and operation

We're building a new global Berlitz, and this is your opportunity to help shape it. Nearly 150 years of expertise, meeting the ambition and technology to power a new era of learning.

If you are the kind of person who thrives in a fast-paced environment, isn’t afraid of a blank page, and is excited to help shape the future of a global company undergoing a significant transformation, you might belong at Berlitz!

We are seeking a Senior Platform & DevOps Engineer to help design and scale our next-generation cloud infrastructure and software delivery ecosystem. In this role, you will take ownership of core areas of our internal engineering platform, partnering closely with the wider engineering team. While our development teams focus entirely on building high-performance services, your mission is to design the "paved road" that allows them to deploy code to production safely, rapidly, and autonomously.

You will work cross-functionally with backend and product teams—providing CI/CD, architectural guidance, and support on shared projects—while enjoying high autonomy and low bureaucratic friction. Best of all, you will work primarily on greenfield services, building modern, clean infrastructure from scratch with minimal legacy debt.

 

What you'll do

  • Greenfield Architecture: Architect, build, and operate secure, multi-account environments across AWS using modern Infrastructure as Code (IaC) principles.

  • Flexible Container Management: Design and optimize container orchestration layers, standardizing on AWS ECS (Fargate) as the primary platform for lean microservices, and reserving AWS EKS (Kubernetes) for the specific cases where heavy workloads or complex scheduling require it.

  • CI/CD Pipeline Design: Build unified, reusable, and secure automated delivery workflows using GitHub Actions and modern deployment tooling.

  • Developer Enablement: Serve as the dedicated platform champion. Provide self-service infrastructure blueprints and automated guardrails so backend developers can own their deployment lifecycle without friction.

  • Observability & Reliability: Establish robust telemetry, logging, and alerting systems (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, CloudWatch) to ensure system health and deep visibility into our greenfield applications.

  • Security by Design: Embed automated security checks, IAM least-privilege models, and secure secrets management directly into the core platform layer.

title: Senior C++ Software Engineer – Real-Time Systems (m/f/d)
description:
Your mission

At enabl, we're bringing AI into the physical world. While everyone else talks about automating office work, we're going after the biggest problem in logistics: 25 million industrial vehicles worldwide are still driven by hand.

Our hybrid system pairs the judgment of experienced drivers with modern automation, and it gets smarter with every deployment. Leading companies in logistics, automotive, and consumer goods already run on our technology.

We're looking for someone to join us by year's end and help build the roadmap to autonomous intralogistics from day one. You'll work on the "nervous system" of our tech. The software that keeps data transmission stable and low-latency, so our forklifts can be safely remote-controlled in real time, anywhere in Europe

  • Impact & ownership: our hierarchies are flat, so your ideas go straight into the roadmap and the product, not into a backlog someone else prioritizes.

Your profile

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Odin is building the investment infrastructure for the future of private markets.
We believe capital is one of the most powerful tools for shaping the world - and more people should know how to put it to work. Our mission is to make it radically easier to raise and deploy capital, so that anyone, anywhere, can back the companies and ideas they believe in.

Our first product is a full-stack platform for launching and running private investment firms - think Shopify for VC and PE. We handle all the infrastructure: from legal structuring and investor onboarding to KYC/AML, payments, tax, reporting, and exits.

We’re already trusted by over 10,000 angels, VCs, and founders. We administer over $500m in assets, covering investments from pre-seed to series E. This includes household names like ElevenLabs, OpenAI, SpaceX, xAI, Anduril, etc. but also new companies creating everything from synthetic brains to small nuclear reactors.

Why we’re hiring

  • We're post-PMF and revenue generating, launching in the US ahead of a Series A. Early enough that you'll shape how engineering works here, late enough that you're not gambling on whether the product works.

  • We also want the bar to move while you're here. Senior engineers set the standard through the quality of what they ship, how they review, and the problems they choose to fix rather than work around.

title: Backend Developer (Java & Python, Microservices)
description:
Your mission

Your mission is to design and maintain a scalable, asynchronous backend that powers OKAPI:Orbits' end-to-end solutions across mission design, Space Situational Awareness (SSA), Space Traffic Management (STM), Flight Dynamics (FD), and Space Traffic Coordination (STC), supporting satellite operators throughout their entire mission lifecycle.

You'll work primarily on external customer projects with a Python-based tech stack, while also contributing in parallel to our products built on Java Spring Boot. You design and implement robust microservices that process and distribute large volumes of orbital and telemetry data to deliver reliable APIs and automation processes. You already bring solid experience and take independent ownership of parts of the backend architecture across both environments.

You'll work on the systems that enable satellite operators and space agencies to analyze, coordinate, and protect their missions in an increasingly crowded space environment.

Studies show that women are less likely to apply for a position if they don't meet 100% of the requirements. Please know that we explicitly encourage you to apply if this applies to you, as long as you bring a passion for space technology, reliable software development, and sustainable use of space.
OKAPI:Orbits already brings together a highly diverse team and is actively committed to growing that diversity further, since studies show that heterogeneous teams achieve better results and drive innovation.


Your tasks and responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain asynchronous, microservice-based backend systems, primarily in Python for external customer projects and in parallel in Java Spring Boot for our products
  • Implement and optimize data processing and distribution pipelines that handle large volumes of orbital, telemetry, and mission data
  • Design and maintain message-based communication structures between microservices (e.g., via RabbitMQ or comparable message brokers)
  • Collaborate closely with space engineers and scientists to translate mission-related requirements into scalable, robust software solutions
  • Share responsibility for the backend architecture across both tech stacks, with a focus on performance, fault tolerance, and maintainability
  • Plan and document implementation steps, from system architecture through deployment in a cloud-native environment

  • Advance CI/CD pipelines, observability, and automation to support stable, continuous releases
  • Analyze and resolve complex issues in distributed systems with a focus on efficiency and reliability
  • Work within small, interdisciplinary teams, contributing your backend expertise to cross-functional projects

description:
memodio is a digital health application (DiGA) fighting forgetfulness and dementia 🧠 Our app is prescribed by doctors, fully reimbursed by German statutory health insurance, and recommended by leading medical associations. We've been on the market for over five years. So we have the speed and ownership culture of a startup, without the chaotic early days: a validated product, paying reimbursement partners, and real users who notice when we ship something good. Now we're growing the engineering team.

Where you sit: anywhere in the world. We're a small distributed team, not a company with a remote policy bolted on. The one requirement is overlap: at least four hours of your working day between 09:00 and 18:00 Berlin time, because we solve problems together, not by throwing tickets over a wall.

How you join us: as an employee or as a freelancer, whichever fits your situation better. Tell us which you'd prefer when you apply.

Tasks

Our core product is live and helping thousands of people, but it's far from finished. A big part of this role is evolving the existing app to better fit the people who actually use it: adults aged 50+, often dealing with early-stage cognitive decline. Every improvement you make has a direct, visible effect on someone's day.

Beyond the core product we're building new and adjacent products, including ones with AI capabilities. If working with LLMs excites you, there's real room to shape that. If it doesn't, that's fine too.

How the role works

You won't get finished designs and implementation specs to execute. You'll get problems, context, and user needs and the freedom to figure out the best solution. That's deliberate: it's where the creativity and the ownership live. It also means the job asks you to think about what to build, not only how.

Today our CTO is hands-on in the codebase, supported by a part-time engineer. You'd join as the next full-time engineer on a small team where your decisions carry real weight.

title: Senior Backend Engineer - Commercial Systems and Intelligence
description:
About the team:

The Commercial Systems and Intelligence squad is a newly formed team within SumUp's Acquisition Mission under the Run & Grow tribe. We sit at the intersection of data, backend engineering, and sales operations, building the infrastructure that powers how SumUp attributes merchant acquisition, calculates commissions, and understands the full lifecycle of every merchant.

Today, these processes are largely manual. We're here to change that, automating what's opaque, and building systems that sales representatives, leadership, and analysts can actually trust. You'll join at the very beginning, helping to shape how the squad works, the architecture it builds on, and the standards it holds itself to.

 

What you'll do:

  • Aggregating data from across the SumUp ecosystem to determine which acquisition channel or sales agent drove a merchant to take a valuable action (e.g. signing up, adopting a product)
  • Establishing data models, API contracts, and rule definitions that automate existing manual commission workflows for field and tele-sales agents, partnerships and merchant referrals
  • Build the Lifecycle Event Log in close collaboration with the Merchant Intelligence squad. A centralized store of curated merchant lifecycle events (signups, product usage, verification, purchases) used across attribution, recommendations, customer support and sales
  • Build internal backoffices and APIs for sales representatives and leaders to monitor commission and modify commission plans, manage portfolios and resolve disputes
  • Define and document API contracts, schemas, and integration patterns that other engineering teams can adopt confidently
  • Establish best practices for testing, observability, and incident response within a newly formed squad
  • Use AI and agentic coding tools deliberately, to scaffold services, write tests, explore unfamiliar code, and draft documentation while maintaining full accountability for what gets shipped

 

You'll be great for this role if you:

  • Bring a strong backend engineering background in Go, or are a typed-language generalist ready to ramp up quickly
  • Have designed APIs and distributed systems with clear contracts, versioning, and integration patterns
  • Are fluent in relational and analytical databases (PostgreSQL, Snowflake) and comfortable making the right choice for the right use case
  • Have built Kafka-based, event-driven systems and understand event sourcing and CDC patterns
  • Have experience in auditable, high-trust systems where every decision must be traceable — fintech, payments, or similar domains
  • Have built services from scratch in greenfield, early-stage squads with limited prior context,  and are energized, not unsettled, by that challenge

Das gibt es zu tun

  • Architektur & Umsetzung Du entwirfst und skalierst verteilte Systeme und Microservices - immer mit Blick auf Wartbarkeit, Stabilität und die Frage, was in zwei Jahren noch trägt. 
  • KI-Features bauen, die im Alltag halten Du entwickelst die Kernfunktionen unserer Plattform - von RAG-basierten Wissensdatenbanken über KI-Apps für einzelne Fachbereiche bis zu Voice-, Übersetzungs- und Analytics-Funktionen.

  • Betrieb & Observability mitdenken Du sorgst dafür, dass Qualität, Kosten und Verhalten der KI-Features im Betrieb sichtbar bleiben - mit Evaluations, Monitoring und klaren Guardrails, damit die Plattform auch bei wachsender Nutzung stabil und effizient läuft.
  • Komplexität beherrschen Du entwickelst bestehende Systeme weiter, schaffst klare Strukturen und reduzierst technische Schulden dort, wo sie langfristig teuer werden und lässt sie stehen, wo sie es nicht sind.

title: Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer
description:
ABOUT US

At Heim, we are reinventing how healthcare is delivered.

We believe that healthcare is best delivered in the home of patients, and that we are at the cusp of a systemic shift away from hospital based care. Our mission is to expand access to in-person clinical care at home by empowering community nurses with technology that makes care delivery more efficient.

We have created an AI native ecosystem that optimises the complex scheduling involved in delivering community based care, and are on track to automate every non clinical touchpoint for nurses.

To date, our technology has powered our network of 400+ practitioners to deliver c. 30K appointments, and we have shown that our algorithms bring down the cost of at-home visits by c.35% whilst freeing up valuable time for care in doing so. We are growing fast and our ambitions are big – with new international markets on the roadmap, and strong investor backing.

Our aim is to create the most productive, AI-enabled distributed clinical workforce working at the intersection of public and private health.By joining Heim, you will play a pivotal role in building the infrastructure that puts clinical care in the home.

WHAT IT'S LIKE TO WORK AT HEIM

We are reinventing how healthcare is delivered. Here are the things that shape your day-to-day:

  • Meaningful problems – we build systems that improve how organisations understand and care for people. The work is complex, applied, and grounded in real-world patient impact

  • High standards, low ego – you’ll work alongside thoughtful engineers, clinicians, and operators who care about clarity and good judgement

  • Speed with intent – we move quickly but deliberately. Clear ownership, evidence-based decisions, outcomes over output

  • Simple, elegant solutions – we have a strong bias towards code that is easy to reason about, hard to break, and built to outlast the sprint it was born in

  • Direct access to founders – you’ll have visibility into and input on the direction of the company

WHAT MAKES THIS ROLE DIFFERENT

This is a full-stack TypeScript role in the truest sense – you will own problems across the entire system, from UI to infrastructure. AI isn’t a feature here; it’s a first principle. We expect you to use agentic coding tools fluently (e.g. Claude Code, Cursor) and to be building your own views on where agentic workflows can meaningfully improve what we ship.

You’ll be working on systems where the stakes are real: scheduling errors affect patient care, data quality issues affect clinical decisions, and downtime has consequences. That context sharpens every technical choice you make.

Wir sind ein Startup für Sprachassistenten und Künstliche Intelligenz aus Karlsruhe und entwickeln moderne Technologien für Spracherkennung und natürlichsprachliche Assistenzsysteme.

Für die Qualität dieser Daten ist sprachliches Detailverständnis entscheidend: Sind Audio und Transkription wirklich korrekt? Werden Zahlen richtig geschrieben? Gibt es systematische Probleme mit Homophonen, zusammengezogenen Wörtern oder anderen Besonderheiten der französischen Sprache? Du arbeitest selbstständig mit unseren Tools und Daten, wirst dabei aber eng von unserem technischen und wissenschaftlichen Team begleitet.

Wenn Du zusätzlich Interesse an Machine Learning und Speech-to-Text-Modellen hast, kannst Du Dich gerne auch in weiterführende Themen wie Evaluation oder Modelltraining einarbeiten. Voraussetzung ist das jedoch nicht – wichtiger sind uns Dein Sprachgefühl, Deine analytische Arbeitsweise und Deine Fähigkeit, mit Python strukturiert Daten zu untersuchen.

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung!

  • Analyse bestehender Datensätze mit Python und unseren vorhandenen Tools

  • Optional: Mitarbeit bei Evaluation, Modelltraining oder weiteren Machine-Learning-Themen

title: Verification Engineer
description:
At Ubitium, we believe the best engineering happens when people with different perspectives tackle hard problems together. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and experiences. What matters most is curiosity, skill, and the drive to build technology that improves the world. If that resonates with you, we’d love to hear from you. SumUp's Point-of-Sale (POS) solution empowers cafes, shops, bars, hair salons, and other businesses to operate efficiently and grow. It offers a wide range of features, including product catalogs, inventory management, business analytics, compliance support, and loyalty tools.

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer: Search Quality
description:
About us

Launched in 2019, Constructor is an AI-first ecommerce search and discovery platform that helps shoppers find the right products at the right time and enables leading global e-commerce brands to drive meaningful revenue and conversion gains.

As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer in the Search Quality team, you will improve the e-commerce experience for hundreds of millions of users across the world by building the systems that power relevance for global retailers - from fashion and grocery to electronics and hardware.

The mission is to measure search quality, push it higher, and catch degradations before the user does. You will achieve this through a blend of fine-tuned LLMs for relevance judgment, real-time models, and deep offline analysis of query logs.


About the Job

Your primary focus will be relevance evaluation and quality improvements:

  • LLM-based evaluation. We fine-tune our own models to assess relevance. This involves teaching the model to understand query intent, represent items from messy catalog data, and align model judgments with real user behavior.

  • Real-time quality in production. Reranking, filtering, signal computation. Latency is a strict requirement, so quality vs speed tradeoff is constant.

  • Automated quality monitoring and agentic insights. Pipelines to detect degradations and find underperforming patterns. Agent-based systems that generate actionable recommendations for the product data and search configurations.


What makes this interesting

  • Multi-domain, multi-language, at scale - 40+ languages, 20+ domains. The models need to generalize across all of them - without per-customer rules or overrides.

  • No universal ground truth. A grocery retailer and a fashion retailer may have different perceptions on what "relevant" means.

  • Efficiency at scale. Optimizing and scaling LLM inference across our entire customer base.


Requirements

  • 4+ years shipping production ML systems

  • Experience with search, information retrieval, or recommendation systems

  • Hands-on experience with fine-tuning, evaluation frameworks, and scaling LLM deployments

  • Strong Python and PyTorch. Fluency in SQL and data orchestration tools (Spark, Airflow)

  • Experience designing and running A/B tests to validate

Our engineers and product managers collaborate closely with cyber security experts to ensure that their hacker's mindset is embedded into our platform.

Our platform is a proprietary Open XDR (eXtended Detection Response) system that brings in security data from several market leading cyber security products into our centralised repository. From here cyber security experts can work their magic. This makes sure that our hundreds of customers experience the same value via automated systems, allowing us to scale in Europe.

About this role

We're looking for a Senior Engineer to join one of our stream-aligned engineering teams. At Eye, we organise engineering around streams: mission-driven groups with a clear outcome to drive, not a product area or a section of the codebase. You'll work in a small, full-stack team of 2-3 engineers contributing to your stream's goal, working across whatever systems and layers are needed to deliver it. This is a role for someone who wants real ownership, not a queue of tickets.

In this role

  • Own features end-to-end as Feature Lead: scope the problem, coordinate work within your team, make day-to-day technical decisions, and ship it to production.

  • Deliver high quality features both individually and with other team members, working full-stack across whatever the stream requires.

  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders to design and develop features that deliver real-world value.

  • Contribute to technical decision-making within your stream, including surfacing tradeoffs and risks early.

  • Participate in creating a psychologically safe and happy environment within the team and the company.

  • The role is remote in the Netherlands or in Berlin, but you commit to travelling to the office (The Hague or Berlin) twice per week.

What you will need

  • 5+ years of development experience, including meaningful full-stack exposure. You are comfortable working across backend and frontend layers and you pick up new technologies independently.

Low-Code / n8n · CRM-Automation · KI-Agenten

Festanstellung | Remote möglich

Du liebst es, Prozesse zu automatisieren, verschiedene Systeme miteinander zu verbinden und aus einer Idee einen funktionierenden Workflow zu bauen?

Dann könnte diese Position sehr gut zu Dir passen.

Wir entwickeln CRM-, Automatisierungs- und KI-Lösungen für Unternehmen. Dabei verbinden wir CRM, Kommunikation, Daten, APIs und moderne KI-Technologien zu automatisierten Prozessen, die unseren Kunden im Alltag tatsächlich Arbeit abnehmen.

Für den weiteren Ausbau suchen wir einen technisch versierten Automation & AI Specialist (m/w/d), der gemeinsam mit uns solche Lösungen entwickelt und umsetzt.

Aufgaben

Deine Aufgaben

Du kümmerst Dich insbesondere um:

  • Aufbau und Weiterentwicklung von n8n-Workflows
  • Entwicklung von Automatisierungen zwischen unserer CRM-Plattform und externen Anwendungen
  • technische Umsetzung und Weiterentwicklung von KI- und Voice-Agenten
  • Anbindung von APIs, Webhooks und Drittanbieter-Systemen
  • Aufbau von CRM-Workflows und automatisierten Kundenprozessen
  • Verarbeitung und Synchronisierung von Daten zwischen verschiedenen Systemen
  • technische Integration von Telefonie, E-Mail, WhatsApp, Kalendern, Formularen und weiteren Tools
  • Erstellung kleinerer JavaScript-, HTML- und CSS-Lösungen, wenn Standardfunktionen nicht ausreichen
  • Fehleranalyse, Testing und Optimierung bestehender Automationen
  • Dokumentation wichtiger Workflows und Integrationen
  • Mitentwicklung neuer Automatisierungs- und KI-Lösungen

Dabei geht es nicht darum, stumpf vorgegebene Workflows nachzubauen. Du sollst Prozesse verstehen, technisch mitdenken und gemeinsam mit uns Lösungen entwickeln.

Qualifikation

Was Du mitbringen solltest

Du musst nicht jede Technologie perfekt beherrschen.

Wichtiger ist uns, dass Du technisch denkst, schnell lernst und Spaß daran hast, Probleme selbstständig zu lösen.

  • CRM-Systemen und CRM-Automatisierungen
  • JavaScript
  • HTML/CSS

Entscheidend ist für uns Dein Verständnis für Logik

title: Quality Assurance Engineer (m/f/d)
description:
Your career oportunity (from 15.09.2026)

You combine strong, hands-on software testing skills with a practical understanding of AI-driven product features and modern AI-supported QA workflows? Also you like to ensure reliable releases across web and/or backend systems, while also contributing to quality strategies for AI-enabled functionality? Then this position might be the perfect fit for you!

Your Mission

  • You own our test strategy end-to-end—and you continuously improve it across both manual and automated testing as we grow.
  • You design, execute, and maintain test cases that cover new features, regressions, and the “it’ll never happen” edge cases.
  • You build reliable automated tests (E2E and API) and you keep them healthy in CI/CD—stable, meaningful, and easy to maintain.
  • You partner closely with Product and Engineering to clarify requirements early, tighten acceptance criteria, and prevent defects before they ship.
  • You define quality signals and metrics that create real release confidence—not just a gut feeling.
  • You raise the bar for AI-feature quality where relevant, including:
    - You test robustness across varied inputs (ambiguous prompts, noisy data, unexpected user behavior).
    - You check safety, privacy, and unintended outputs in line with product requirements.

Requirements

Your Superpowers

  • Your Superpowers
    • You’ve worked in software testing / QA engineering in cross-functional teams and you know what great collaboration looks like.
    • You’re strong in test design, exploratory testing, and defect investigation—you enjoy finding root causes, not just symptoms.
    • You have solid hands-on experience with test automation (e.g., Playwright, Cypress, Selenium) and API testing (e.g., Postman, Bruno).
    • You’re comfortable with CI/CD and version control (e.g., Git and GitHub/GitLab pipelines) and you treat testing as part of delivery.
    • You understand modern software delivery practices like shift-left QA, code reviews, observability, and documentation—and you apply them pragmatically.
    • You have working knowledge of AI/ML or LLM-powered features and you can translate that into practical quality checks.
    • You communicate clearly and think pragmatically—you balance quality, speed, and risk to help the team ship responsibly.
  • Nice to Have
    • You’ve tested AI/LLM features before (prompt variations, guardrails, unexpected outputs, evaluation approaches).

description:

To become the car-changing destination of choice. By combining technology, media and deep automotive expertise, we've turned how people buy, sell, advertise and lease cars on its head.

What started as a simple reviews site is now one of the largest online car-changing destinations in Europe. Last year alone we grew over 50% with nearly £3bn worth of cars bought on site, while £1.8bn of cars were listed for sale through our Sell My Car service.

title: Security & Compliance Engineer - Remote Germany
description:
About Linro

Linro is a cloud security company building a real-time, agentic cloud-security platform. Teams ship with AI. AI ships with Linro.

Cloud infrastructure changes constantly, and increasingly it's AI agents making those changes, not people. Most security tools only catch problems after the fact. Linro works differently. We enforce what's allowed at every stage, from commit to production. We stop bad changes before they ship, and fix problems in real time once they're live.

We have each been on the receiving end of this problem: running cloud security at scale, building the platforms underneath it, and shipping in regulated systems where a wrong change isn't an option. Founded in Berlin in 2026 and built fully remote across Europe, Linro has a platform that's real and working, with plenty still to shape.

The role

You will own Linro's security and compliance program end to end, starting from a blank page. Your job is to build that from scratch: figure out where we actually stand, find the gaps, and close them across a multi-cloud environment. Automate what can be automated instead of redoing the same work by hand every quarter.

What you will do

  • Take SOC2, ISO 27001 and 42001 from a blank page to audit-ready. Run the gap analysis, document controls and policies, gather and map evidence, track remediation to done, and get us through audit.

  • Automate compliance instead of just babysitting it: build checks and guardrails so we stay continuously compliant, and help ensure our multi-cloud infrastructure (AWS and beyond) is managed as Infrastructure-as-Code with Terraform.

  • Own our compliance evidence end to end: keep it current, mapped, and audit-ready across whatever tooling we run.

  • Support security operations: monitoring, alert triage, and documenting findings.

  • Stay close to how the product is actually built. Our compliance checks run on the same engine we sell customers, so you are testing the product, not filling out paperwork off to the side.

What we are looking for

  • Hands-on experience with at least one of SOC 2, ISO 27001, or ISO 42001: you have run a gap analysis, built and mapped evidence, and taken a program through an actual audit, not just studied the framework. Experience across more than one is a plus.

title: Solution Architect (all genders)
description:
Your creative field

We are looking for two full-time, permanent Solution Architects to start as soon as possible. We're filling this role at two levels. See below where you recognise yourself. We live remote-first, but you have the freedom to choose whether you want to work hybrid or completely on-site due to your proximity to one of our locations.


You open your laptop in the morning and know that today will probably be different from what you planned. Maybe you're in a refinement session and realise halfway through that the proposed solution won't hold up at scale. Maybe a developer asks a question that makes you rethink a concept you thought was finished last week. Some days are structured, some aren't – but you know how to work with both.

This isn't a greenfield. At Contabo Group, two systems run in parallel: a PHP monolith with 15 years in production, grown across multiple teams and generations of decisions and a younger microservice system with a message broker built over the last few years. Together they serve more than 250,000 customers worldwide. You know that a landscape like this has its own logic and that you don't redraw it from scratch, but take the time to understand it before you start changing it.

Your job is to develop this landscape further. That means retiring legacy systems where it makes sense, keeping the architecture clean even when there's business pressure to cut corners, and bringing teams along rather than issuing mandates. You own the solution architecture across software, infrastructure and networking – and you make sure decisions are made transparently, not in a vacuum. If you naturally share what you know, not because it's in the job description but because you understand that bad architecture eventually hits everyone – then this is likely the right place for you. 


What convinces us

Your personality, paired with:  

Must have:
• Architectural knowledge for complex, distributed systems 
• Solid understanding of the hosting domain – you know what happens behind a VPS booking 
• Systems modelling with UML, C4, BPMN, ERD, or FMC (e.g. Drawio, Visio, Mermaid) 
• 5+ years of experience, with 2+ years focused on architecture 
• Fluent in German and English 
 
Should have: 
• Experience with Kubernetes, Ansible, or comparable IaC tools 
• Some or deep experience migrating monolithic systems to microservices 
• Mentoring background 
 
Nice to have: 
• AI tools in everyday development (e.g. Claude Code) 
 
We're filling this role at two levels. See where you recognise yourself: 
 
Senior - You own the full architecture responsibility and set the standard for all teams.

title: Senior Backend-Entwickler – Agents (100% Remote / German-Speaking)
description:
Wir suchen Senior Developer, die in unserem vollständig remoten Team an unseren Agenten arbeiten. Wenn du Komplexität magst und willst, dass deine Arbeit wirklich etwas bewegt, passt du zu uns.

Über uns
Hausverwalter.ai ist eine All-in-One-Plattform für Hausverwaltungen, mit Funktionen wie Inbox, CRM, Dokumenten, Telefonie, Video Calls, Team Chat und KI-Agenten. Unsere Mission ist es, alles zu automatisieren, was ein Hausverwalter tut.

Über die Rolle
Unsere Plattform ist von Tag eins an agentisch gedacht. Bevor wir überhaupt die UI geplant haben, haben wir geplant, wie Agenten mit der Software arbeiten. Denk dran – unser Ziel ist, die ganze Branche zu automatisieren, und das meinen wir ernst.
Heute gibt es für fast alles, was der Nutzer in der UI machen kann, ein Agenten-Tool, und der Co-Pilot (der tägliche Assistent des Nutzers) kann alles für ihn übernehmen, sogar den Dark Mode an- und ausschalten.
Aber der Co-Pilot ist erst der Anfang. Die eigentliche Herausforderung sind die autonomen Agenten. Dazu unten mehr.

Woran du arbeiten wirst

  • Inbox-Agents: Autonome Agenten, die anspringen, sobald in einem Ticket etwas Neues passiert. Kunden trainieren sie selbst ODER nehmen einfach eine der Vorlagen, die du für sie baust. Diese Agenten können heute schon komplette komplexe Abläufe allein übernehmen und sind einer der Hauptgründe, warum sich Kunden für unsere Software interessieren. Aber wann sollte ein Agent an einen Menschen abgeben, statt selbst zu Ende zu machen? Wie stellen wir sicher, dass er sich an den Prozess hält? Das sind deine Fragen.

  • Harness Engineering: Der Agent hat über 100 Tools. Aber er muss eine Anfrage so verstehen, wie ein Hausverwalter sie versteht, und nicht so, wie die Begriffe außerhalb der Branche klingen. Was gehört in den System Prompt, was in Skills?

  • Knowledge Base: Unsere Plattform hat eine eigene Knowledge Base, ähnlich wie Notion. Komplett selbst gebaut und gedacht als kollektives Gehirn des Unternehmens. Aber sollte die KI auch von selbst „lernen"? Und wenn ja, wann? Und wie machen wir die Suche in der Knowledge Base besser — über bessere Tools, System Prompts oder Skills?

  • Voice-Agents: Dieselben Agenten, nur am Telefon — auf LiveKit gebaut, die Anrufe genauso abwickeln wie unsere Text-Agenten Tickets.

  • LLM Infrastructure. Das richtige Modell für die jeweilige Aufgabe wählen, per Caching und Streaming die Latenz drücken, bei Provider-Ausfällen sauber neu versuchen, Context kompakt halten, die RAG-Suche optimieren, Usage über alle Provider tracken, Kosten senken und mit Evals prüfen, was wirklich besser ist.

title: Senior Applied Research Engineer - Video
description:
Synthesia is the world’s leading AI video platform for business, used by over 90% of the Fortune 100. Founded in 2017, the company is headquartered in London, with offices and teams across Europe and the US.

As AI continues to shape the way we live and work, Synthesia develops products to enhance visual communication and enterprise skill development, helping people work better and stay at the center of successful organizations.

Following our recent Series E funding round, where we raised $200 million, our valuation stands at $4 billion. Our total funding exceeds $530 million from premier investors including Accel, NVentures (Nvidia's VC arm), Kleiner Perkins, GV, and Evantic Capital, alongside the founders and operators of Stripe, Datadog, Miro, and Webflow.

About the role

As an Applied Research Engineer in our Video team, you will help build the next generation of production-grade foundation models for human-centric video generation.

You will join a highly focused team working at the intersection of large-scale generative modeling, distributed systems, and production engineering. Our mission is to develop and optimize video base models that power realistic, controllable, and emotionally expressive synthetic humans at scale.

This is not pure research. This is applied research with direct product impact.

You will work on advancing training recipes, scaling distributed systems, improving evaluation frameworks, and optimizing inference to ensure our models are high quality, stable, and efficient enough for real-world deployment. Your work will directly influence models used by tens of thousands of businesses worldwide.

What you’ll do

You will own and execute end-to-end research and engineering projects, from hypothesis to production impact. This includes:

  • Developing and scaling latent video diffusion models tailored for human-centric video generation

  • Designing conditioning mechanisms to improve control (pose, emotion, script, camera) without sacrificing fidelity

  • Advancing distributed training strategies (DDP, FSDP, DeepSpeed, sequence parallelism) under real compute constraints

  • Improving training stability at multi-node scale

  • Designing rigorous evaluation frameworks combining automated metrics and structured human evaluation

  • Optimizing inference for low latency, high resolution, and cost efficiency<

title: VP, Growth
description:
About Nivoda

Nivoda is the operating system for the global jewellery industry. Our B2B marketplace connects jewellery retailers with diamond, gemstone and jewellery suppliers in 70+ countries, and we process $300M+ in annual transactions in a $350B industry that has barely been touched by technology.

We remove the traditional barriers of capital, geography and information asymmetry. An independent jeweller in Ohio can source from a cutter in Mumbai with the same ease, pricing and confidence as one of the world's largest chains. That's the whole point.

Our Mission 🚀

Diamond and gemstone trading has run on inefficiency, opacity and exclusivity for generations. Relationships were gatekept, pricing was hidden, and the size of your business decided the terms you got. We're building the infrastructure that changes that — so any jewellery business, anywhere, regardless of size, can compete on the quality of what they do rather than who they know.

The Marketing Team ⭐️

We're a remote-first, low-hierarchy company where the best idea wins. Marketing at Nivoda is at an inflection point: we have real product-market fit, thousands of businesses transacting, a category we have the opportunity to redefine, and a marketing function that has not yet been built to match the scale of the opportunity.

About the Role

We're hiring a VP of Growth to build Nivoda's marketing function from the ground up and turn it into a predictable growth engine for a two-sided global marketplace.

This is a builder's role, not a caretaker's or maintainer’s. You'll own the strategy, the growth model, the budget, the team and the number. You'll be the person who decides what Nivoda's category story is in partnership with the CEO, how we reach tens of thousands of independent jewellers and suppliers, and how we prove — with data, not decks — which of those bets are working.

You'll report directly to the President and sit on the senior leadership team, with a mandate that spans demand generation, product marketing, brand, content, lifecycle and marketing operations across every market we trade in.

  • Building the marketing team from its current base: hiring, structuring and levelling up a global team, and building the systems, briefs and feedback loops that make good marketers great

title: Director of Product
description:
Who we are:

We're one of Europe's fastest-growing fintech companies – on a mission to create the world's most empowering way to pay.

We launched the product in 2020 and achieved double unicorn status, valued at $2 billion, and since then have taken on more than 6 million customers.

 

Our mission is to become the best way to pay for anything, anywhere and say goodbye to credit costs for everyone. This is huge. Want to join us?

About the role.

Zilch operates in a fast-paced, highly competitive global market. Though still young, we are one of Europe’s fastest-growing fintechs - and we’re looking for a Director of Product to lead the next phase of innovation and growth.

In this role, you’ll drive the development of new financial products, intelligent purchase experiences powered by AI, and data-driven commerce capabilities that make Zilch the top-of-wallet choice for customers. You will lead five product squads, delivering the most efficient and flexible ways for customers to pay, manage credit, and shop using Zilch-issued Visa cards.

As a hands-on product leader, you’ll combine strategic ownership with deep involvement in product discovery, delivery, and optimisation. You’ll set high standards for your teams - mentoring, challenging, and empowering them to turn complex problems into scalable, high-impact products. You'll also be accountable for driving the P&L for your portfolio, ensuring every initiative delivers measurable customer and commercial outcomes.

What you'll do.

  • Lead and empower five cross-functional product squads to deliver high-impact outcomes across purchase, payments, and repayment journeys.

  • Drive the P&L and commercial performance of Zilch's financial and payment products, driving sustainable growth and strong unit economics.

  • Define product strategy and roadmaps across multiple squads, aligning priorities with Zilch's commercial and growth objectives.

  • Set clear product goals, monitor KPIs, and use data, experimentation, and customer insight to continuously optimise performance and customer value.

  • Demonstrate hands-on product leadership by driving discovery, shaping solutions, and partnering closely with Engineering and Design throughout delivery.

  • Balance long-term product strategy with day-to-day execution, ensuring teams consistently deliver customer and business impact.

For many people living with chronic pain, the journey has been long. They have tried multiple medications, procedures and therapies, yet their pain continues to impact every aspect of daily life. By the time they reach us, many are looking for another option where conventional treatment has fallen short.

We are Montu UK, one of the UK's largest medical cannabis clinics, and we are looking for Consultants specialising in Pain Management to join our clinical team.

You will assess and manage patients exploring cannabis based medicines, making the clinical decision on whether treatment is appropriate and managing their care from there. We provide comprehensive specialist training, and our multidisciplinary model means you are never working in isolation. title: Ecommerce Brand Manager
description:
Entropy sells survival, power and preparedness gear in the US. Around $525k a year, currently at contribution margin neutral. Almost all of it is other people's product resold at 9-12% margin, which caps what the business can earn.

Own-brand product and better acquisition economics are the fix. That's the job.

You'd own the P&L and report to Jack and Lasse weekly. Nobody else is doing this.

Tasks

  • Own blended gross margin, moving it from 12% to 25%, and take the business through breakeven.
  • Source and launch own-brand SKUs. Suppliers, MOQ negotiation, samples, freight, duty, 3PL, listings, launch.
  • Run paid acquisition yourself. Google Shopping, PMax and Search. There's no agency and there won't be one.
  • Site and conversion work. Product pages, imagery, copy, checkout, cart abandonment.
  • Build attach and post-purchase revenue. Checkout upsells, replenishment, email flows.
  • Restart the content engine. Video cadence, TikTok, YouTube, UGC and reviews.
  • Manage the existing dropship catalogue on margin, cutting what doesn't pay.
  • First 90 days: paid spend cut on every SKU below 15% margin, even where that drops revenue. Google Ads moved in-house. First own-brand order placed. Attach offers live at checkout. Blended gross margin at 16%.

Requirements

Must have:

  • Launched a physical product end to end. Sourced it, negotiated MOQ, approved samples, managed freight, priced it, listed it, sold it
  • Run Google Ads yourself on a Shopping-led store. In the account, not briefing an agency
  • Owned a gross margin or P&L number, not a revenue or ROAS number
  • Operated at $500k-5m, where you wrote the product page and answered the customer emails
  • Comfortable cutting revenue to fix margin
  • Work independently. No team, no budget approver, nobody checking your work between weekly calls

Nice to have:

  • Built checkout attach, upsells or replenishment flows
  • Sold consumables or anything with repeat purchase
  • Worked with Chinese suppliers, or US co-packers and contract manufacturers
  • US import, duty classification, 3PL setup
  • Klaviyo or equivalent, built from scratch rather than inherited
  • Bundle and kit pricing
  • Preparedness, outdoor, hunting or adjacent category knowledge

We're also open to people from outside ecom. Founders whose company didn't work out, consultants who want to operate, anyone who has built something and can show it. The mechanics are learnable. The instinct isn't.

Not for you if you want a team, a budget, or someone telling you what to do next week. Or if a 25% revenue drop in month one would be a problem.

Benefits

€65-75,000 base. Equity from 5%, up to 10% earned against margin and profitability targets. Quarterly bonus on gross margin. Fully remote, anywhere in Europe

Alongside the technical build, you will lead the governance and security-by-design practices that ensure every data asset, model, and AI use case meets Intersnack's standards for explainability, traceability, and regulatory compliance.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AWS Cloud Engineer/Architect based in Germany.

This is an opportunity to design and deliver modern cloud solutions that solve complex business challenges for organizations across Europe.
You’ll work across AWS architecture, cloud-native development, infrastructure automation, migrations, and modernization initiatives.
The role combines hands-on engineering with architectural thinking, giving you the opportunity to influence both technology decisions and client outcomes.
You’ll collaborate closely with engineers, technical teams, and customers to simplify complexity and deliver scalable, secure, and effective solutions.
Your work will span infrastructure as code, CI/CD, observability, application performance, security, and cloud cost optimization.
You’ll also have the opportunity to mentor teams and share practical expertise around AWS architecture and DevOps best practices.
With a fully remote setup and a strong culture of collaboration and continuous learning, this role offers meaningful technical ownership and flexibility.


Accountabilities:
  • Design and architect scalable, secure, highly available cloud solutions on AWS using cloud-native architecture and DevOps best practices.
  • Build and implement cloud infrastructure and applications that address complex customer requirements and deliver measurable business value.
  • Develop infrastructure as code using tools such as Terraform, CloudFormation, or AWS CDK to enable consistent, repeatable deployments.
  • Automate infrastructure and application deployment, configuration, and management through CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions or comparable technologies.
  • Collaborate with internal engineering teams and customers to understand business objectives, progressively deliver solutions, reduce unnecessary complexity, and demonstrate the impact of technology decisions.
  • Develop and implement effective monitoring, logging, alerting, and operational strategies using AWS CloudWatch or third-party observability platforms.
  • Optimize cloud applications and infrastructure for performance, scalability, security, reliability, and cost efficiency.
  • Evaluate and integrate third-party cloud tools and services where they can improve automation, security, performance, or operational efficiency.
  • Work with development and operations teams to establish effective cloud deployment and operational practices.
  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship on AWS architecture patterns, DevOps methodologies, cloud-native development, and operational best practices.
  • Translate complex technical concepts into clear, accessible recommendations for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

title: Payment Operations Lead
description:
Payment Operations Lead

Global expansion is broken. Without a local company, conversion rates fall, costs rise, and compliance gets messy. Outpost fixes it.

Selling internationally is a maze of tax, payments, and operational friction. Most brands avoid it, or expand slowly and expensively.

Outpost is your modular back office for global commerce.

Pick only what you need - tax, payments, treasury, or operations - and unlock new markets without the overhead. Sometimes we become liable for a merchant's taxes. Sometimes we become the legal reseller in each market and carry the payments, tax and compliance risk. Other times, we give you the tools to do it yourself.

We go live wherever a merchant needs to sell next, for digital and physical goods. That means we own the full stack - payments, tax, compliance, treasury, and merchant experience.

Sell anything, anywhere. Without compromise.

🧠 The Role

We're looking for a Payment Operations hire to own the part of Outpost where the money actually moves.

When we become the legal reseller in a market, we take the payment. Every merchant we onboard gets its own merchant ID and its own merchant category code, never pooled into one shared code, which is exactly why our approval rates beat the alternatives. Keeping that true across every market, every processor and every merchant is the job.

This is a quantitative role in an operational seat. You'll live in the transaction data: why authorisation rates differ by market, issuer, card type and hour of day, what a routing change is actually worth, where a 40 basis point cost difference is hiding, which decline codes are recoverable and which are noise. Then you'll act on it, with processors, with engineering, and with merchants.

You won't be siloed. Payments at Outpost touches pricing, treasury, tax and the product roadmap, and you'll be pulled into all of it. But your edge is the numbers, and we want someone whose first instinct on any problem is to pull the data and model it.

You'll work directly with the founding team and with engineering, who will build what you spec.

Yes, the work is intense. But in return you'll get scope and exposure most people wait 10 to 20 years to access.

title: Head of Operations
description:
🌍 About Outpost

Global expansion is broken. Without a local entity, conversion rates fall, costs rise, and compliance gets messy. Outpost fixes it.

Selling internationally is a maze of tax, payments, and operational friction. Most brands avoid it or expand slowly and expensively.

Outpost is your modular back office for global commerce.

Pick only what you need — tax, payments, treasury, or operations — and unlock new markets without the overhead. Sometimes we act as Merchant of Record, taking on tax and compliance risk. Other times, we give you the tools to do it yourself.

We operate across 58+ tax jurisdictions for digital and physical goods. That means we own the full stack — payments, tax, compliance, treasury, and merchant experience.

Sell anything, anywhere. Without compromise.

🧠 The Role

We're looking for our Head of Operations: the person who owns how Outpost actually runs.

Today, operations at Outpost is a set of processes held together by a small group of very good people. Merchant onboarding, KYC/KYB, market launches, tax registrations, payouts, treasury approvals, chargebacks, merchant support — it all works, but it works because people push it. Your job is to turn that into a machine.

This is a hands-on leadership role, not a management layer. You'll own the operational stack end to end: onboarding and activation, merchant operations, payments and treasury ops, compliance monitoring, and new market launches. You'll design the processes, build the tooling requirements with engineering, write the playbooks, and then run them yourself until they're good enough to hand over.

You'll hire and grow a small team behind you, but for the first stretch you are the team. If your instinct when something breaks is to open the dashboard and fix it rather than schedule a meeting about it, you'll do well here.

You'll work directly with the CEO and founding team, and you'll have a real say in what Outpost builds — operations is the sharpest source of product signal we have.

🧗 What You'll Get

Yes, the work is intense. But in return, you'll get scope and exposure most people wait 10–20 years to access.

You'll own a core function of a company solving one of the hardest problems in global commerce, work with senior stakeholders across PSPs, banks, tax authorities and merchants, and build a team from scratch. We won't handhold, but we'll coach you hard.

title: Solution Architect (all genders)
description:
Your creative field

We are looking for two full-time, permanent Solution Architects to start as soon as possible. We're filling this role at two levels. See below where you recognise yourself. We live remote-first, but you have the freedom to choose whether you want to work hybrid or completely on-site due to your proximity to one of our locations.


You open your laptop in the morning and know that today will probably be different from what you planned. Maybe you're in a refinement session and realise halfway through that the proposed solution won't hold up at scale. Maybe a developer asks a question that makes you rethink a concept you thought was finished last week. Some days are structured, some aren't – but you know how to work with both.

This isn't a greenfield. At Contabo Group, two systems run in parallel: a PHP monolith with 15 years in production, grown across multiple teams and generations of decisions and a younger microservice system with a message broker built over the last few years. Together they serve more than 250,000 customers worldwide. You know that a landscape like this has its own logic and that you don't redraw it from scratch, but take the time to understand it before you start changing it.

Your job is to develop this landscape further. That means retiring legacy systems where it makes sense, keeping the architecture clean even when there's business pressure to cut corners, and bringing teams along rather than issuing mandates. You own the solution architecture across software, infrastructure and networking – and you make sure decisions are made transparently, not in a vacuum. If you naturally share what you know, not because it's in the job description but because you understand that bad architecture eventually hits everyone – then this is likely the right place for you. 


What convinces us

Your personality, paired with:  

Must have:
• Architectural knowledge for complex, distributed systems 
• Solid understanding of the hosting domain – you know what happens behind a VPS booking 
• Systems modelling with UML, C4, BPMN, ERD, or FMC (e.g. Drawio, Visio, Mermaid) 
• 5+ years of experience, with 2+ years focused on architecture 
• Fluent in German and English 
 
Should have: 
• Experience with Kubernetes, Ansible, or comparable IaC tools 
• Some or deep experience migrating monolithic systems to microservices 
• Mentoring background 
 
Nice to have: 
• AI tools in everyday development (e.g. Claude Code) 
 
We're filling this role at two levels. See where you recognise yourself: 
 
Senior - You own the full architecture responsibility and set the standard for all teams.

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
About Nucs AI

Nucs AI is revolutionizing cancer care through cutting-edge AI and medical imaging technology. Founded in 2024 by a multidisciplinary team of oncologists, AI researchers, and healthcare innovators, we’re tackling one of medicine’s most pressing challenges: the growing demand for accurate, timely cancer diagnostics in the face of rising scan volumes and limited radiologist capacity.

We sit at the intersection of diagnostics and treatment planning—building AI-powered tools at the convergence of medical imaging, radioligand therapy, and artificial intelligence. Starting with prostate cancer and expanding across oncology, we partner with world-leading medical institutions and pharmaceutical companies across the US, Europe, and Australia to bring precision oncology into everyday clinical practice.

Our mission is to enhance diagnostic precision and expand access to expert-level cancer care, improving patient outcomes worldwide. We’re venture-backed, early-stage, and building a team that blends deep clinical expertise with engineering intensity—moving with the rigor the medical field demands and the speed the problem deserves.

The Opportunity

Nucs AI is looking for a Senior Product Manager who thrives at the intersection of complex technology and specialized end-users. You will own critical parts of our product roadmap, translating deep clinical and technical requirements into clear product direction, then driving execution across data, engineering, regulatory, and commercial areas. This is not a role where you manage a feature backlog in isolation; you will be expected to build conviction around what we should build, why, and in what order, and to defend that thinking rigorously.

What You’ll Do

Product Development Support

  • Own the roadmap for one or more product lines (e.g., DeepPSMA, SelectPSMA, TrackPSMA), balancing clinical impact, technical feasibility, and business value.

  • Engage directly with clinicians, nuclear medicine physicians, and oncologists to deeply understand their workflows, pain points, and decision-making processes.

  • Translate ambiguous, technically complex problems into well-structured product requirements and clear success criteria.

  • Develop and articulate a clear product narrative: why this feature matters, who it serves, and how it connects to the broader platform vision.

title: IT System Engineer (m/w/d)
description:
Gestalte komplexe IT-Systemlandschaften im Gesundheitswesen

Du möchtest nicht nur Tickets bearbeiten, sondern komplexe IT-Systeme verstehen, optimieren und gemeinsam mit Kunden weiterentwickeln? Dich reizt eine Rolle, in der Systemintegration, Infrastruktur, Datenbanken, Netzwerke und Kundenkommunikation zusammenkommen? Dann erwartet Dich hier eine abwechslungsreiche Position mit viel Eigenverantwortung.

Für unseren Partner, ein etabliertes Softwareunternehmen mit Fokus auf die Digitalisierung von Gesundheitseinrichtungen, suchen wir einen IT System Engineer (m/w/d).

Gemeinsam mit Deinem Team sorgst Du dafür, dass moderne Enterprise-Content-Management-Lösungen (ECM) und Dokumentenmanagementsysteme (DMS) bei Kunden zuverlässig implementiert, betrieben und kontinuierlich weiterentwickelt werden.

Dich erwartet eine komplexe Systemlandschaft mit zahlreichen technischen Schnittstellen und individuellen Kundenanpassungen. Statt standardisierter Routineaufgaben arbeitest Du an maßgeschneiderten Lösungen und bist technischer Ansprechpartner für Kunden – von der Implementierung über Systemerweiterungen bis hin zur Fehleranalyse und Optimierung.

Aufgaben

  • Installation, Konfiguration und Inbetriebnahme moderner Enterprise Content Management (ECM)- und Dokumentenmanagement-Systeme (DMS)

  • Einrichtung, Konfiguration und Optimierung technischer Schnittstellen sowie Durchführung von Datenmigrationen
  • Analyse und Behebung technischer Störungen per Remote-Zugriff im 2nd-Level-Support
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem 1st-Level-Support auf Kundenseite zur nachhaltigen Lösungsfindung
  • Direkter Austausch mit Kunden zur Analyse technischer Anforderungen und Entwicklung individueller Lösungen
  • Unterstützung der IT-Consultants und Projektteams bei technischen Fragestellungen
  • Erstellung und Pflege technischer Dokumentationen sowie Wissensdatenbanken
  • Mitarbeit in einem 19-köpfigen Team, aufgeteilt auf drei spezialisierte Fachbereiche
  • Aktive Mitgestaltung und kontinuierliche Optimierung bestehender IT-Infrastrukturen und Systemlandschaften

Qualifikation

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium der Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder eine Ausbildung als Fachinformatiker für Systemintegration bzw. eine vergleichbare IT-Qualifikation
  • Berufserfahrung als IT System Engineer, Systemadministrator, IT Consultant, IT Support Engineer, Technical Consultant oder IT Systemadministrator
  • Sehr gute Kenntnisse im Microsoft Windows Server-Umfeld

  • Erfahrung mit SQL sowie grundlegendes Datenbank

If you are the kind of person who thrives in a fast-paced environment, isn’t afraid of a blank page, and is excited to help shape the future of a global company undergoing a significant transformation, you might belong at Berlitz!

Berlitz's brand hasn't had a dedicated design owner. You'll partner closely with Marketing on brand strategy, but you'll own how that strategy actually looks and feels everywhere it shows up. You'll also work alongside the product design team to make sure brand and product pull in the same direction, extending our shared design system rather than working apart from it.

What you'll be doing

  • Own brand guidelines and visual identity end to end: typography, color, imagery, and motion, documented clearly enough that a global, multi-country organization can actually follow them.

title: Data Scientist with focus Bioinformatics / Diagnostics (f/m/d - part/full-time)
description:
Your responsibilities will include

  • Analysis of multiomics data (e.g., NGS, transcriptomics, metabolomics) in oncology / inflammation
  • Support non-clinical / clinical development in all phases, analysis plan (e.g. SAP), reporting
  • Implementation and reporting of exploratory biomarker analyses
  • Serving clients with ad-hoc data analysis requests and statistical consulting
  • Following quality and documentation standards in a GxP environment
  • Supporting the bioinformatics/statistics team, as well as independent work in diverse and exciting projects


Your profile

  • Master’s degree / PhD in bioinformatics, computer science, or equivalent education 
  • Experience in analysing multiomics and biomarker data (e.g., NGS data including transcriptomics); gene set analysis and clustering is a plus
  • Experience in setting up / executing bioinformatics pipelines using e.g. Nextflow, containerisation 
  • Solid knowledge and understanding of statistical concepts e.g. hypothesis testing, survival analysis, linear models, as well as experience in the application of advanced statistics visualizing, exploring and modeling multivariate data sets
  • Very good programming skills in R / Bioconductor; Shell-scripting and Git is a plus
  • Good overview of state-of-the-art bioinformatics tools and proven record of the ability to collect, combine and analyse complex types of data 
  • Fast comprehension, analytical thinking, teamwork and a high degree of initiative, willingness to learn
  • Creativity and joy in solving complex analytical questions and proactive working style
  • Very good English skills, German is an advantage



What we offer you

We value communication, flat hierarchies, open corporate culture, and a harmonious work environment. We offer comprehensive individual development opportunities, continuous trainings, and flexible working hours. A modern and bright office with a subsidised canteen, as well as the opportunity to work 2 days per week from home are part of our everyday working life. Full remote work from anywhere in Germany for those who do not live in Munich can be discussed. You will join an interdisciplinary team allowing you to discuss with and learn from peers with many different backgrounds.

title: Chief Product and Technology Officer - Remote - Healthtech (m/w/d)
description:
In Deutschland geben Patienten jährlich 30 Milliarden EUR beim Zahnarzt aus. Trotz dieser Marktgröße arbeiten viele Praxen noch immer mit veralteter Offline-Software aus den 80er Jahren. Roger ist hier, um das zu ändern.

Wenn du technologiebegeistert bist, Verantwortung übernehmen willst und in einem schnell wachsenden Umfeld wirklich etwas bewegen möchtest, bist du bei Roger richtig.

Aufgaben

  • Features zur Optimierung des Praxisalltags entwickeln: Deine Hauptaufgabe besteht darin, neue Features zu konzipieren und umzusetzen, die den Arbeitsalltag in Arztpraxen erleichtern.
  • Praxisverwaltungssysteme (PMS) verstehen und analysieren: Du führst Analysen und Reverse Engineering der Praxisverwaltungssysteme durch.
  • Datenabgleich und Nutzerfeedback einholen: Durch den Abgleich von Datenstrukturen mittels SQL und das Einholen von direktem Nutzerfeedback gestaltest du praxisnahe, bedarfsgerechte Lösungen. Ein umfassendes Verständnis der medizinischen Realität wird dir helfen, passgenaue Features zu entwickeln.

  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit unserem CEO

  • Product Management: Du kennst die Ins und Outs, wenn es darum geht Produkte zu bauen die Kunden begeistern
  • Abgeschlossenes Studium, idealerweise im medizinischen, wirtschaftlichen oder IT-Bereich.
  • 2-3 Jahre praktische Erfahrung als (Senior) Product Manager:in in einem Healthtech Start-up/ Scale-up
  • Sehr gutes technisches Know-how um Produktanforderungen an das Engineering Team weiterzugeben
  • Wachstumsdrang/Growth Mindset: Tiefe Verpflichtung zu persönlichem und beruflichem Wachstum, immer offen für Feedback und neue Lernmöglichkeiten.
  • Persönliche Fähigkeiten: Analytisches und strukturiertes Arbeiten, Eigeninitiative, selbstständige Problemlösung, Lernbereitschaft und Freude an der Arbeit im Team
  • AI-First-Mentalität
  • Sprachkenntnisse: Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse.

Nice to have:

  • SQL-Kenntnisse
  • BigQuery
  • Führungserfahrung

Benefits

  • Karrierechance
  • Lebendige Kultur: Tauche ein in eine Kultur mit tatsächlich flachen Hirarchien, die Innovation, Teamarbeit und Spaß bei der Arbeit feiert.
  • 100% Remote und flexible Arbeitszeiten: Arbeite vollständig von zu Hause und gestalte deine Arbeitszeiten flexibel nach deinen Bedürfnissen.

System Architecture Consulting

Strategic Customer Partnerships

title: Engineering Manager: Agentic Integrations
description:
About Us

Launched in 2019, Constructor is an AI-first ecommerce search and discovery platform that helps shoppers find the right products at the right time and enables leading global e-commerce brands to drive meaningful revenue and conversion gains.

About the Role

As an Engineering Manager on the Agentic Integrations team, you’ll lead engineers building and scaling integrations for Constructor’s agentic products across our customer base. This team sits within the ML Journey chapter and operates at the intersection of customer needs, applied ML, product engineering, and production integration work.

Your team will work directly with customers and internal teams to bring agentic capabilities into real-world retail workflows, helping customers adopt, configure, extend, and scale these products in their environments. The work spans two fronts: delivering high-quality customer integrations for agentic products, and turning repeated implementation patterns into reusable tooling, frameworks, documentation, and platform capabilities that make future integrations faster and more reliable.

You’ll be responsible for setting the technical and operational direction for the team: how we engage customers, how we make integration work scalable, how we maintain quality across a growing number of deployments, and how we turn customer-specific learnings into product and platform improvements. Success in this role requires strong engineering leadership, customer empathy, excellent prioritization, and the ability to work effectively across Product, ML, Customer Success, Solutions, and core Engineering teams.

Challenges you will tackle

  • Scaling agentic integrations: Be a part of building a new team that can take agentic capabilities from promising product functionality to reliable, production-grade customer deployments across many different customer environments.

  • Balancing customer delivery and scalable foundations: Allocate the team’s capacity across hands-on customer integration work and longer-term investments in reusable tooling, templates, documentation, automation, and platform improvements.

  • Cross-functional collaboration and prioritization: Work closely with Product, ML, Customer Success, Solutions, and other Engineering teams to prioritize customer needs, unblock adoption, and ensure integration learnings feed back into the product roadmap.

  • Technical direction and quality: Set a high bar for architecture, testing, observability, reliability, and maintainability in customer-facing integrations, especially where agentic systems interact with customer data, workflows, and business-critical experiences.

title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.


The Role

We are looking for a Talent Acquisition Specialist to support hiring across multiple functions and regions as BJAK continues to scale globally.

This is a hands-on recruitment role for someone who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment, managing multiple hiring priorities, and partnering closely with stakeholders to deliver hiring outcomes. You will have exposure to a wide range of functions including Operations, Finance, Marketing, Creative, HR, Product, Engineering, and other business-critical teams.


What You’ll Do

  • Manage end-to-end recruitment processes for assigned roles across multiple functions and locations.

  • Partner closely with hiring managers to understand hiring needs, candidate profiles, and business priorities.

  • Source, screen, assess, and engage candidates through various channels including LinkedIn Recruiter, referrals, job boards, and direct outreach.

  • Build and maintain strong talent pipelines for both active and future hiring needs.

  • Conduct talent mapping and market research to support hiring strategies.

  • Coordinate and manage interview processes while ensuring a positive candidate experience.

  • Maintain accurate candidate records and recruitment activities within the Applicant Tracking System (ATS).

  • Provide regular hiring updates and pipeline insights to hiring managers and stakeholders.

  • Support recruitment process improvements, hiring initiatives, and employer branding activities where required.

About Precoro

Precoro is an agentic procurement, AP and spend management platform.

Most mid-market finance teams find out what they spent after they spent it. Someone chases purchase orders over email, someone keys invoices into the ledger, and the Finance Director learns what a site committed several weeks after it committed it. The software built to fix that was designed for the Fortune 500: six-figure licences, rollouts measured in quarters, a consulting partner attached to the contract. Everyone below that line got left with spreadsheets.

We built Precoro for the companies underneath it. A £60m business with four sites gets the control a global one has, live in about three weeks, on the finance system it already runs: Sage, NetSuite, Microsoft Dynamics or Xero. Spend gets approved against budget before the money moves. Invoices reconcile against orders and receipts on their own. The CFO sees committed spend the day it is committed rather than at month end.

The AI work is the part we are most excited about, and it is where this category is heading. Agents raise and chase POs, route approvals to the right budget holder, read invoices and match them to orders and goods received. Procurement is close to an ideal case for it: the work is high volume, rule bound, and nobody enjoys doing it. Every hour absorbed is an hour a six-person finance team does not need to hire a seventh person to cover.
